title: Code and derived data: a pre-registered test of a convolutional-recurrent network for forecasting soil organic carbon change

creators.name: Hasan, Md Rakib

description: Analysis code and derived panel for a pre-registered test of a hybrid convolutional-recurrent architecture against gradient boosting, on repeatedly sampled LUCAS topsoil observations. The LUCAS source data are not redistributed here, since their licence does not permit it; the code rebuilds the panel from files obtained directly from the European Soil Data Centre.
